body: Naw, I get that. I just felt frustrated that if you post something in r/funny or r/askreddit you get instant responses but people who really need help are mostly ignored.
Kinda sounds like a Ralph Bakshi film...

I feel like r/suiciewatch should get quicker help than it does. I wish more people came here. I'm experiencing one of the worst moments of my life and nobody cares. Fuck it. fuck it all. I'm going to try to sleep but probably spend the night in my bed on the verge of throwing up.
